description:
UIUtil

Please note that this mod has now entered maintenance mode.
From now on, this mod will not receive new features or be refactored. I will only accept feedback and fix severe bugs that may prevent the game from running correctly.
This status will begin today (October 24, 2025) and will last for approximately one year.
The current version (v5.0.0) is considered stable and is safe to use.

A detailed explanation and my thoughts
Recently, while refactoring the core of UIUtil, I've hit some bottlenecks. Combined with some matters in my personal life, I've been feeling very drained and somewhat overwhelmed. As a developer, I've reached a point where I'm not satisfied with the quality of the code I'm producing.

In order to take care of these real-life matters and to prevent shipping low-quality code while in a poor state of mind, I have decided to pause all my mod development activities for approximately one year.

Regarding UIUtil:
- The ongoing refactoring work (including the core and planned API refactor) has been archived. I will re-evaluate it upon my return.

Regarding the new future project (a form of Roguelike):
- This is an idea I'm very excited about, but its complexity is also immense. I will organize all the current design documents and wait for a better time to start it.

For me, modding is about the joy of creation and sharing, and I don't want it to become a burden. Thank you all for your understanding, and I'll see you in the future.

Need BoxUtil

This is a lightweighted UI prerequisite mod that provides two main features:

Disk series wheel select panels
UI series UI panels

Provides test campaigns to quickly verify if the mod's features work properly on your device
Provides benchmarks to test how much load the UI panels and shading put on your device!
Provides a impl mission of UIUtil: A classic snake game...can you beat the game?

Demonstration and Manual download

What you might care about:

This mod won't work on devices that don't support GL42, GL43
This mod uses BoxUtil for shader compilation and efficient text rendering
Highly customizable with configurable parameters
This mod is licensed under the MIT License
Document is waiting for translation

If you encounter any bugs or have other requirements, please provide feedback

Log
v2.x
- 25/6/6 minor update v2.1.2:
1. Added a series of get methods to SelfUIRenderEngine
2. Fixed bugs related to using MID Distributions in SelfUIFrame and SelfUIBanner
3. Fixed size bug in SelfUILabel
4. Added a mult parameter to the render methods of SelfUIRenderEngine and SelfUIComponent

- 25/6/8 Minor Update v2.2.2:
1. The private variable stress in SelfUIDynamic has been renamed to decorated
2. Added customData related methods to the SelfUILayoutBlock interface
3. Added a new class SelfUIStatic for content initialization
4. Fixed a shader compilation bug caused by driver issues
5. The text size of SelfUILabel will now adapt to the text aspect ratio instead of being forcibly stretched
v3.x
- 25/6/29 Major Update v3.2.2:
1. Massive refactoring of UI panel-related code
1. Switched to a chainable (or stream) construction style
2. SelfUIWidget no longer handles updates and rendering; these functionalities are now implemented through interfaces like SelfUIRenderer
3. Introduced three coordinate systems — offset, location, and absLocation:
- offset: relative to siblings
- location: relative to parent
- absLocation: relative to the entire UI panel
(Note: both location and absLocation are derived from offset)
4. Added a lock mechanism to disable certain operations (e.g., setting parent, adding child nodes)
2. Added: SelfUIListener, SelfUIListenerManager, and SelfUIFactory
3. Added a new UI component: SelfUICheckBox , which is clickable during gameplay
4. UI now automatically adapts to changes in position and size

- 25/7/6 Minor Update v3.3.2:
1. Keep refactoring:
1. remove interface SelfUIWidget, instead using a class
2. added destory() for some classes for life span controling
2. Added SelfUIShaderRenderer, a shader renderer base class
3. Added a game to play

- 25/8/9 Minor Update v3.4.2:
1. Keep refactoring:
1. Moved layout and mount functionality out of SelfUlWidget, now managed by SelfUlLayoutInfo and SelfUIRegistry
2. Added SelfUlLayoutUpdater for custom layout handling
3. Removed render and advance methods from SelfUlEngine – now use setters to control isWorking, location, and scale
4. Moved all rendering, event listening, and updating to Manager classes for performance improvement
5. SelfUIEngine now requires calling submit() after initialization to begin rendering and processing
2. Added new components: SelfUlButton, SelfUlEntry, SelfUlTypeArea, and a vanilla-style frame component: SelfUlVanilaTooltipFrame
3. Added new renderer: SelfUlBorder
4. Bug fixes and optimizations
5. SelfUIRegistry now supports plugin retrieval by custom ID, type, and binding mode for better plugin interoperability
v4.x
- 25/9/21 Major Update v4.4.2:
1.  Added an ImGUI-style construction flow: SelfUI
2.  Added SelfUIBuilder and SelfUIDataBuilder classes, defining a type-safe and fluent construction specification. Supports custom Builders and seamless chaining.
3.  Added the SelfUILayoutMode class and its static implementation container class, SelfUILayoutModes, with support for custom layout modes.
4.  Added basic layout algorithms: SelfUIGrid, SelfUIFlow, and SelfUIAbs.
5.  Added the SelfUISession interface and abstracted SelfUIEngine into this interface.
6.  Standardized the construction methods for SelfUIFactory and various control classes.
7.  Standardized lifecycle management: Attachments implementing the SelfUIDisposable interface will now automatically be managed by the lifecycle system upon being added.
8.  Added the new SelfUISlider control, along with its vertical and horizontal implementations.
9.  Added `move` and `swap` methods to SelfUIWidget to support runtime structure modification.
10. Added a `working` state and its corresponding getter/setter methods to SelfWidget.
11. Added a font size setting to SelfUITextField.
12. Added the `isClicked` method to SelfUIButton to get the click state for the current frame.
13. Added sound effects and their configuration to SelfDiskPanelPlugin, which play when switching options.
14. Added a `boolean hit` parameter to SelfUIMouseListener's listener methods, eliminating the need for manual hit checking. Mouse events will now only trigger the topmost listener.
15. Optimized the shaders for SelfUIColorSpan and SelfUISprite.
16. Fixed an issue where SelfDiskPanelPlugin could not clear its cache correctly.
17. Fixed an option offset issue in SelfDiskPanelPlugin.
18. Fixed an issue where SelfUIEntry could not clear the cursor, and optimized its code.
19. Fixed an issue where `engine.scale` was not being applied correctly.
20. Fixed a flickering issue on some devices.
21. Fixed a concurrent modification issue when adding attachments to various Managers.
22. Removed the `init` and `destroy` methods from SelfUIRenderer.
23. Cleaned up obsolete code.
24. Standardized the formatting of some comments.

- 25/9/21 Patch Update v4.4.3:
1. Fixed the issue of payload order
2. Optimized the performance of SelfUlVanilaTooltipStyle

-25/9/30: Minor Update v4.5.3:
1. Applied generics to SelfUILayoutMode for its SelfUILayoutData, eliminating the need for type casting on getLayoutData methods.
2. Added SelfUIFlex layout mode.
3. Fixed an issue where SelfUIButton did not highlight on mouse hover.
4. Fixed an issue where styles were repeatedly applied within SelfUIIMContext, causing a continuous increase in render instances.
5. Standardized the SelfUIWidget modification process by adding the SelfUIFactory.asConfiguringView(SelfUIWidget widget) method and changing the visibility of the SelfUIBuilder(SelfUIWidget widget) constructor.

-25/9/30: Patch Update v4.5.4:
1. Fixed an issue where SelfUIFlex failed to correctly skip inactive widgets.

-25/10/04 Minor Update v4.6.4:
1. Added SelfLineDrawer and improved line rendering.
2. It is now abled to create UI panels in window coordinates in the campaign map.
3. Added the SelfUINone layout mode.
4. Added the LogicalWidget mechanism to SelfUIWidget to standardize the behavior of composite components.
5. Unified horizontal and vertical sliders into a single SelfUISlider component.
6. Added a 'hover' parameter to SelfUIMouseListener methods to support more complex mouse behaviors.
7. Removed unused parameters from the submit method in SelfUIColorSpan and SelfUISprite.
8. Removed leftover test code from SelfUILayoutMode.
9. Fixed an issue where a listener implementing multiple Listener interfaces was not added correctly to all corresponding listener lists.
10. Fixed a concurrent modification issue in SelfUIDestructionManager.
11. The SelfUIWidget.addItem() method has been renamed to addChild().
12. The SelfUIWidget.update() method no longer supports method chaining.
13. The default layout mode for SelfUIWidget has been changed to 'None'.

-25/10/05 Patch Update v4.6.5:
1. Fixed an issue with missing various LogicalChild-related methods.
2. Fixed an issue where SelfUICampaignInterface could not be serialized correctly, which prevented UI panels from being re-added.
3. Added a new method, isCampaignStatusReady(), to UIUtilGlobal to ensure that BoxUtil is ready when a UI panel is created.
v5.x
-25/10/07 Major Update v5.0.0:
1. Revised the package structure to prevent potential naming conflicts. (Apologies for this breaking change!)
2. Standardized the versioning scheme.
3. Dropped official support for version 0.97.
4. Removed the SelfHandler and SelfSupplier interfaces.
5. SelfUIButton now supports passing in callback functions.

-25/11/15 Patch Update v5.0.1:
1. Changed all manager classes to use a command buffer to fix concurrent modification bugs.
2. Removed redundant and junk code (InstancingManager, "oo").
3. Removed the SelfUIEntry class. Now, an Entry can only be created via the relevant methods in the SelfUIFactory class.
4. Removed the getEntity method from SelfUITextField and added a constructor that directly accepts a Supplier<TextFieldEntity>.
5. Added a SelfUIButton constructor that does not take a callback function.
6. Slightly optimized the performance of SelfUIColorSpan.
7. Fixed a display bug in SelfUISlider.
